programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: The Tesla Files
programme.desc: Why were trunks belonging to genius inventor Nikola Tesla confiscated in 1943? Did they contain the plans for nearly free worldwide electricity, massive death rays, and other inventions out of the future? A new investigation driven by declassified CIA documents suggests a secret history of bitter rivalries, government conspiracies, Cold War and WW2 spycraft, extra-terrestrial communication, and amazing achievements of a truly gifted man – Nikola Tesla.

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: After the fall of France in 1940, Dönitz's trio of aces embark on a race to sink British merchant ships. In Britain, the woman who will frustrate his plans turns the Women's Royal Naval Service into a force to be reckoned with.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Former Green Berry Terry Schappert explores the stories of some of the most iconic warrior groups in history, including their weaponry, training, fighting tactics and more. The veteran investigates what made these legendary fighters great, but also what were their weaknesses. Join him as he looks into the battling masteries of the Vikings, the Samurai, the Spartans and more.

programme.title: Gold Hunters: Legend of the Superstition Mountains
programme.desc: Legend tells of the Lost Dutchman's gold mine hidden somewhere within the 160,000 acres of brutal Arizona desert known as the "Superstition Mountains." The promise of a $200 million mother lode has lured thousands of treasure hunters and continues to claim the lives of those eager to decipher the legend's clues and riddles. Hunting for the Lost Dutchman is typically a one-man journey, but lifelong Dutch Hunter Wayne Tuttle is breaking with tradition and partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure. With cursed mountains said to drive men mad and a hidden fortune of gold worth killing for, the treasure hunter's greatest danger may be the man at his side. Trust at your own peril if you dare to tread into HISTORY's Legend of the Superstition Mountains.

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Documentary series that brings back to life lost cities, structures, cultures, and civilisations, transporting viewers back in time and revealing the truth behind some of history's most iconic eras. Using a combination of cutting-edge technology and archaeological research, the team detail what life was like for these places during their peak of their powers, and use visual overlays to compare past and present landscapes. From the Knights Templar to the lost city of Atlantis, ancient Egypt to Hitler's planned supercity, and ancient Athens to America's wild west, each episodes dives into these extraordinary remnants of human history.

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: When Roman generals Pompey and Crassus lead their mighty legions of soldiers and mercenaries into the lands surrounding Italy, neither could anticipate the turmoil caused by one bold mercenary: Spartacus. A Thracian warrior, Spartacus deserts the Roman army, but is captured and made a slave, forced to fight as a gladiator. But in 73 BC the untamable barbarian leads a slave revolt of 70,000 gladiators against the Roman Republic. Though the brutal and conniving Roman General Crassus is finally able to suppress the revolt, his rival, the more popular Pompey, takes all the credit, sparking a division within the Republic itself that will ultimately spell its demise.

programme.title: Missing in Alaska
programme.desc: The Alaska Triangle, a region in northwest Alaska, has more unsolved missing person cases than anywhere else in the world. Over 20,000 people have vanished in the past 50 years alone. Who or what's behind these cases is unknown. Some believe it's the work of local predators or simply the rugged, dangerous terrain, but legends thrive in Alaska, and the ominous history of disappearances in the area has drawn comparisons to the Bermuda Triangle. Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: Lost Relics of the Knights Templar
programme.desc: Lost Relic Hunters follows the work of one of the world's most prolific collectors of antiquities, Hamilton White, and his long-time friend and business partner, Carl Cookson. The intrepid duo are back on the trail of some truly astonishing relics and historical pieces, which, if authenticated, will potentially change our understanding of some of the most iconic periods of British and European history. Aided in their adventures by cultural and art historian Dr Janina Ramirez, Lost Relic Hunters sees Carl and Hamilton journey to breath-taking locations around the world including Venice, Istanbul, Barcelona, Jerusalem and the Pyrenees, in their quest to authenticate the rare and precious antiquities from Hamilton's collection.

programme.desc: Утренняя новостная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Ждём в гости
programme.desc: В Тбилиси у гостей столицы в последнее время пользуются большой популярностью необычные места. Именно они позволяют лучше узнать дух старого города, быт горожан вне туристических маршрутов. Например, таким примечательным местом является блошиный рынок у Сухого моста - кладезь для любителей старины и коллекционеров. Также в выпуске: замечательный кулинар предлагает вместе с ней сходить на рынок, купить продукты и приготовить блюда для застолья в уютной домашней атмосфере тбилисской семьи.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека

programme.title: Французская кулинария
programme.desc: После многочисленных любовных неудач француженка Луиза встречает в Париже мужчину своей мечты - русского красавца Виктора. Но счастье Луизы оказывается недолгим. Виктор вынужден вернуться в Россию. Ему предложили должность арт-директора в новом ресторане французской кухни в провинциальном Таганроге. Девушка отправляется в Россию искать Виктора. Однако, приехав в Таганрог, Луиза узнает, что у нее есть соперница - владелица ресторана Юля, в прошлом - королева красоты \"Мисс Таганрог 2007\". Решив вернуть Виктора во что бы то ни стало, Луиза выдает себя за шеф-повара французской кухни и устраивается работать в ресторан Юли. Проблема только в том, что Луиза вообще не умеет готовить…

programme.title: Дочь за отца
programme.desc: Счастливая жизнь Веры заканчивается в один день. Она узнаёт, что её отец сядет в тюрьму по ложному обвинению в коррупции и убийстве. Вера намерена выяснить правду, найти настоящих виновных в преступлениях и вытащить отца из тюрьмы. programme.title: Хоккей. Чемпионат мира
programme.desc: Чемпионат мира по хоккею с шайбой пройдёт с 15 по 31 мая 2026 года в Швейцарии. 16 команд начнут свой путь к заветному титулу Чемпиона мира, разделившись на 2 группы. Игры Группы А (действующий чемпион мира - США, Швейцария, Финляндия, Германия, Латвия, Австрия, Венгрия и Великобритания) состоятся в Цюрихе. Команды группы В (Канада, Швеция, Чехия, Дания, Словакия, Норвегия, Словения и Италия) поборются за выход в четвертьфиналы во Фрибуре. Групповой этап Чемпионата мира пройдет с 15 по 26 мая. Четвертьфиналы состоятся 28 мая, полуфиналы - 30 мая. Медали Чемпионата мира по хоккею с шайбой 2026 будут разыграны в воскресенье 31 мая.

programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Голое влечение
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Уловки разума
programme.desc: Следователь по особо важным делам Кира Карелина, чье невероятное чутье помогло разгадать множество преступлений, начинает ощущать на себе давление всевозможных версий и гипотез. Маньяк? Серийный убийца? Или что-то еще, более темное и загадочное? В то время как Кира погружается в пучину запутанных улик и непонятных свидетельских показаний, в городе появляется некий Константин Холмогоров, психотерапевт из Москвы, известный своими необычными методами и странными способностями. Его подход к проблемам уникален: он использует регрессивный гипноз, чтобы проникнуть в самые глубины человеческого разума и извлечь там скрытую правду.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.title: Anderson Cooper 360
programme.desc: Anderson Cooper delves into the day's news, looking beyond the broadcast to give his take, prompting us to re-think what we hear in the headlines. Cooper has covered major, international stories like the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina on the Gulf Coast, the catastrophic BP oil spill and the 2010 earthquake in Haiti, which saw the whole world fall silent. The show has won an absolute plethora of awards over the years, including GLAAD Media and Emmy awards.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Clayton is a compulsive liar, but Gumball discovers he wasn't lying about his awesome martial arts move. Gumball confronts Clayton about his fabled Seven Pressure Point Heart Exploding Technique, assuming it's another one of his outlandish claims. Darwin and Gumball intervene to help Clayton start embracing the truth. However, when they discover the move is as effective as he claimed, they really wish he'd been lying.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

Clarence lives with his mother Mary and her boyfriend Chad in the fictional town of Aberdale, and he is optimistic, curious, honest and quirky boy, who sees the best in everyone and gets himself in a variety of funny situations and everyday problems, which he solves with lots of imagination and with the help from his friends.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Amazing World of Gumball revolves around the life of Gumball Watterson a 12-year-old cat who attends middle school in the fictional city of Elmore. Accompanied by his adoptive goldfish brother and best friend Darwin he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city during which he interacts with his other family members - sister Anais and parents Nicole and Richard - and an extended supporting cast of characters. With relatable themes and a unique cast of characters The Amazing World of Gumball exemplifies the funny amazing sweet and optimistic side of kids' everyday life. Injected with a good deal of humor and unpredictable nonsense Gumball's world reflects the modern family and everyday issues that kids understand.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: When Darwin asks Gumball to teach him how to skate Gumball makes sure that he covers every aspect of the skating lifestyle - from wearing the right gear using the right terms and choosing the right board. But when Darwin finally gets his wheels rolling he realises there might be one important aspect of skating that Gumball hasn't taught him...

programme.title: Quest
programme.desc: Take a chance to explore magnificent cities all around the world with the help of XP Guide with TravelXP. The hosts will walk you through the streets of cities in the four corners of the Earth, will introduce you to local cuisine, show you the night life, demonstrate modern and ancient architecture, provide the best shopping places. Even if you do not plan to visit this very city it will be absolutely entertaining and eye-opening experience. And if you get inspired by some particular place, do not forget to turn off TV before you go on the road.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: For many years passion for travelling has been bringing people to unexplored continents, countries and places to look into culture, history, food, nature and people. This kind of passion if the key point of Backpack, a travel show that opens new spots all over the world by a show host travelling solo with a backpack. So make yourself comfortable and enjoy visiting Serbia, Spain, Israel, India, Egypt and many more. Take a look at the historical past and modern life, find out about traditions, get to know tourism hotspots and treasures of nature, plan your future vacations with the help of show hosts' recommendations.

programme.title: 10 Days Sri Lanka
programme.desc: 10 Days is a Travelxp show about discovering unexplored places and their cuisine and interacting with the locals. It is time to go on a wonderful journey to Sri Lanka, uncover its never-ending enigma and experience the best of what this exotic country has to offer. Enjoy the show and add a new place to your list of new places to visit. programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Jalgpall: Hispaania LaLiga. Real Sociedad - Real Betis
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. programme.title: Pöörased
programme.desc: Don otsustab oma korteri maha müüa. Joan satub Los Angelese reisil olles suhtesse. Glen teatab Bettyle ja Sallyle, et ta läheb Vietnami.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: Tüdrukud on suurte intriigide tõttu tülis, Laura ei taha Kristinat näha ja vastupidi. Misha satub petturi ohvriks ja mässib ennast kiirlaenu rägastikku, tal ei jää muud üle kui politseisse avaldus teha ja ta leiab samas uue töökoha toidukullerina. Maria tahab korraldada suure leppimispeo, kuid leppimine pole sugugi lihtne. Samal ajal tuleb maalt Laura noor musklimehest sugulane Ken-Robin tema koju elama ja pöörab neil koduse elu täiesti pea peale.

programme.title: Kullakesed
programme.desc: Dorothy, Blanche, Rose ja Sophia on neli eakat vanadaami. Nende kõigi suurimaks ühiseks jooneks on nende abikaasad - kõik on kas surnud või lahutand. Neli vanamemme otsustavad kokku kolida, et vanaduspõlve hõlpsamaks ning huvitavamaks teha.Kuid samas pole mitte ühelgi neist kadunud ammune janu meeste järgi. Igaüks üritab endale pidevalt kaaslast leida ning vahest ka teiselt üle trumbata.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Konstaabel Paabel üritab oma pereelu uuesti rööpasse saada, kuid naine seab tingimuseks, et mees peab politseist töölt ära tulema. Rein on raske valiku ees, kas jäta pere nimel oma kutsumus? Vahepeal aetakse taga relvastatud ja ohtlikku jalgrattaröövlit, saadakse ootamatu vihje liputaja kohta ja Rein saab viimaks oma vanemad lepitada ja tema isa kolib katseajaga tagasi ema juurde. Relika korraldab oma ema pimekohtingul segaduse ja Rein käib koos naisega perenõustaja juures. Siis juhtub aga midagi, mis sunnib Reinu oma otsuseid uue pilguga üle vaatama - Kulbi tänava inimsööjajuhtum muutub korraga väga isiklikuks.

programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Kooselu uue naisega kujuneb Vernerile ohtlikuks, sest tema elunatuke on mitu korda juuksekarva otsas rippunud. Pärast viimast õnnetust, kus Verner ennast peaaegu sodiks sõidab, otsustab ta naisest lahku minna, kuid too oskab siingi olukorrast välja tulla, teatades, et on rase.

programme.title: Beverly Hills, 90210
programme.desc: Brandon naaseb San Franciscost. Andrea armub Jessesse. Donna näeb kummalisi unenägusid. John Sears üritab Steve aidata.

programme.title: Skandaal
programme.desc: Endine USA Presidendi meediasuhete konsultant Olivia Pope on nüüd kriisijuht, kes suudab lahendada kõik probleemid nii, et keegi ei teagi, et sellised probleemid olemas olid. Kuid ükskõik kui hoolas sa oled oma töös, võid samal ajal enda eraelus väga palju kahju teha. Igal nädalal seisavad Olivia ja ta meeskond silmitsi paljude probleemidega, mis vajavad lahendamist. Ning kui nad suudavad päästa teiste inimeste elusid, ei tähenda see seda, et nad suudavad parandada ka enda omi.

programme.title: Pöörased
programme.desc: Partnerid avastavad, et firma kaotab oma iseseisvuse. Petel ja Trudyl on raskusi oma tütre erakooli sisse saamisega.

programme.title: Rannavalve
programme.desc: Ühes Los Angelese rannas tegutseb vetelpäästjate rühm, mida juhib Mitch Buchannon. Nad päästavad elusid, maadlevad eraeluliste muredega, võitlevad kuritegevuse vastu ja löövad kaasa uskumatutes seiklustes.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Udumunal on terviseprobleeme, ent kui kohale jõuab külaarst (Peeter Kaljumäe), lähevad asjad kontrolli alt päris välja. Arst kahtlustab Riinat ja Urmast (Hilje Murel ja Sepo Seeman) perevägivallas, põhjustab oma ravivõtetega terviserikke nii Jürkale (Ago Anderson) kui Priidikule (Henrik Normann) ning ainult ämma (Ene Järvis) sekkumine päästab olukorra. Stsenarist Peep Pedmanson, reþissöör Rando Pettai. Tootja Ruut.

Wadowsky, toimetaja Tiina Lokk, näitejuht Rein Oja, režissöörid Toomas Kirss ja Kalev Lepik. Peaosadesmängisid Merle Palmiste, Marika Vernik, Ita Ever, Märt Visnapuu ja Ivo Uukkivi. Portreteeritakse elu Kadriorus erinevatel päeva- ja aastaaegadel, varahommikust öötundideni, kõigis pargi piirkondades. Surnukeha leidsid silla alt juhuslikud möödujad, kes märkasid teel verejälgi. Heino oli selleks hetkeks juba 10 päeva kadunud olnud. Kuidas see juhtus ja miks leiti laip mehe kodust 25 kilomeetri kauguselt? Kas mängus võis olla keelatud armuafäär?

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.desc: Aleksei Rõbnikovi rokkooperi ekraniseering. Lugu legendaarsest Ladina-Ameerika folkloorikangelasest ja Tšiili luuletaja Pablo Neruda poeemist.

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville ja kompanii on tagasi kolmandas järjeshow's, kus valitsevad ohtlikud kaskadööritrikid ja avameelsed paljastused.

programme.title: Suhete mänguväljak
programme.desc: Jalgpallurist südametemurdja satub saatuse tahtel laste jalgpallimeeskonna treeneriks. Sellest hetkest muutub jalgpalliplats tema hoolealuste ja nende veetlevate emade suhete mänguväljakuks.

programme.title: Saage tuttavaks - Dave
programme.desc: USA 2008 komöödia Lavastaja: Brian Robbins Osades: Eddie Murphy, Elizabeth Banks, Marc Blucas, Gabrielle Union, Ed Helms, Scott Caan Värskelt New Yorki saabunud Dave Ming Chang (Eddie Murphy) on otsekui kala kuival. Miski tema juures on viltu, mees näeb kõike ümbritsevat otsekui esimest korda ega tunne end oma kehas kuigi mugavalt. Põhjusega, sest tegelikult ei olegi "Dave" üldse inimene, vaid hoopis teiselt planeedilt saabunud… kosmoselaev, mis on loodud oma kapteni (Eddie Murphy) näo järgi. Avastusretk tundmatusse maailma alaku!

programme.title: Tuhat sõna
programme.desc: USA 2012 komöödia Lavastaja: Brian Robbins Osades: Eddie Murphy, Clark Duke, Cliff Curtis Jack McCall on libekeelne kirjandustoimetaja, kes on oma tahtmise saamiseks võimeline ütlema mida iganes. Kuid peagi tuleb ka tal ette hetk, mil ta oleks pidanud oma sõnadega ettevaatlikum olema, kuna pärast alusetu lubaduse andmist vaimse guru Sinjale muutub tema elu peatselt väga keeruliseks. Nimelt Jacki tagaaeda kasvab üleöö üks maagiline puu, mis iga Jacki poetatud sõna peale langetab ühe lehe ja iga langenud lehte võib arvestada kui sammu lähemale Jacki surmale.

programme.title: Nanny McPhee - võlurist lapsehoidja
programme.desc: Suurbritannia 2005 komöödia Lavastaja:Kirk Jones Osades:Emma Thompson (Nanny McPhee), Colin Firth (Mr. Brown), Angela Lansbury (Adelaide), Kelly Macdonald (Evangeline) ja teised Cedric Brown on äsja kaotanud oma naise ja peab hoolitsema oma seitsme lapse eest, kes on nii üleannetud, et kõik lapsehoidjad on põgenenud. Nüüd ütleb müstiline hääl talle, et ta peaks palkama Nanny McPhee, kes on eriliste võimetega maagiline naisterahvas. Lastel on õnnestunud minema kihutada 17 eelmist lapsehoidjat, ent kui Nanny McPhee tegutsema asub, märkavad nad, et nende üleannetu käitumine lõpeb nüüd sujuvalt ja imeväel üsna ootamatute tagajärgedega.

programme.title: Addamsite perekond
programme.desc: Oscari parimate kostüümide nominent. Põrgulik Addamsite perekond ootab põnevusega rõõmsat sündmust: kadunud onu Festeri naasmist, mis toob terve klanni üle aastate jälle kokku.

programme.title: Addamsite pereväärtused
programme.desc: Kolmanda lapse sünd toob Addamsite perele sekeldusi juurde ja vanemad lapsed tahavad pesamunast vabaneda. Festeriga flirtiv nägus lapsehoija osutub rikkaid mehi jahtivaks mõrtsukaks ja aferistiks.

programme.title: Kondimurdjad
programme.desc: Komöödia vangidest, kes teevad jalgpallimeeskonna, et valvuritega jõudu katsuda.

programme.title: Jõmpsikate metsikud seiklused
programme.desc: Jõmpsikad mässivad end seiklusse, kus neid abistavad Thornberry'de pere liikmed. Nood reisivad ümber maailma ja filmivad dokumentaalfilme loodusest.

programme.title: Põgenev pruut
programme.desc: Romantiline draama väikelinna iludusest Maggi Carpenterist (Julia Roberts), kes armastab hirmsal kombel pulmakleidis altari ette kõndida ent siis põgeneda. Tavaliselt lõpeb jalutuskäik altarini laulatusega, kuid Maggie'ga juba nii ei juhtu - tema on juba kolm korda altari ette jõudnud ja täpselt samapalju kordi sealt tuhatnelja põgenenud ja kõik peiud pika ninaga jätnud. Argpüks? Meestesolgutaja? Vastuse jahil saabub väikelinna Ike Graham (Richard Gere) - New Yorgi reporter, kes soovib veidrast pulmapõgenikust loo kirjutada.

programme.title: Poisid peale selle
programme.desc: Robin jagab Jane'iga sõitu New Yorgist Los Angelesse. Nad peatuvad sõbranna juures Pittsburghis ja teekond läände teeb nad omavahel veel lähedasemaks.
